name: Gaussian Splatting Attribute Prediction
aliases: Hierarchical Network built on residual correction
definition: A voxel transformer that predicts residuals added to initial Gaussian rendering attributes on voxels, rather than generating new attributes directly.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Attribute Prediction refines 3D primitives by predicting additive residuals to initial attributes, avoiding full regeneration to preserve high-frequency details lost in coarse initializations.
